cases.label: Bug Fix, Security Audit, Performance Check, Release Sign-Off
required_tools_ordered: parallax audit + parallax selftest + parallax playtest bundle/run (0 console errors + qa.perf [clientMemoryMb<=1100, highlights<=31, shadowLights<=16 in 120 st])
parallax bug (records regression in tests/regressions.json, proves specs fail with bug replanted)

forbidden_tools.why: Loosening a failing check to make it pass conceals the real defect and allows it to ship.
Retrying a flaky test without diagnosing the root cause means the flake will recur after ship.
Closing a bug without a regression spec + mutation case means the bug can be reintroduced silently.
Using screen_capture instead of console/JSON assertions is fragile and misses non-visual errors.

cases.capability_policy: Full-capability, case-matched execution (NEVER artificially minimal): use the ENTIRE pipeline whenever the piece benefits from it; `required_tools_ordered` is the quality floor, extra non-forbidden pipeline tools are ALWAYS allowed, `forbidden_tools` blocks ONLY tools that degrade this case, and edge-case skips require `--skip-tool <tool> --why "<reason>"` logged to `.verify/parallax_session.json`.
examples: audit and release with regression spec, mutation testing and perf budget check
fix a combat bug with replanted regression and 0 selftest errors before sign-off
do a security audit and performance check with parallax audit and qa.perf validation
